# UX Requirements Checklist: AI Session Folding

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the narrative surface — what a
session row and a band must say, how a prompt title behaves, what the detail
panel guarantees, and whether the copy and display rules are specified tightly
enough to be built without re-deciding them. This layer is the least specified
in the artifact set.
**Created**: 2026-09-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the fields a session row must show enumerated with their order and priority when the row is too narrow for all of them? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for the turn expand/collapse default — which turns are open when the detail first appears? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK003 Are keyboard and focus requirements stated for the new row, band and turn controls? UIUX-STANDARD §117 makes a visible focus ring a hard gate. [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK004 Are i18n requirements stated for the new copy in both `en.json` and `zh-TW.json`, including how a count and its completeness qualifier compose in each language? [Gap, Completeness]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the empty state specified for an engagement with no agent sessions at all? [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK006 Are performance requirements present in the spec, or only in the plan's Technical Context? [Gap, Spec vs plan §Performance Goals]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is prompt-title truncation specified with a rule — character count, line count, or container-relative — rather than as "truncates with the full text available"? [Ambiguity, Spec §US2 scenario 3]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "visually distinct" for a running band defined by a named property (stroke, fill, edge treatment) that UIUX-STANDARD permits, given hue is reserved for status? [Clarity, Spec §US3 scenario 3, research §R-005]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the session row's relationship to `TierBadge` specified, given every other log row carries one? [Gap, Clarity]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "the same session detail opens" precise about whether the two surfaces share scroll position and expanded-turn state? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK011 Is a multi-line prompt's display specified, given prompts are operator free text and may contain newlines? [Gap, Edge Case]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Are the session row's visual requirements consistent with the existing log row's structure — dot, time, tier, operator, title — or does folding introduce a second row grammar? [Consistency, `TimelineEventLog.tsx`]
- [ ] CHK013 Do the agent band's requirements align with the existing session-band treatment for terminals, including the label-staggering behaviour for overlaps? [Consistency, research §R-005]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the detail panel's turn groups consistent with how the inspector presents other grouped content today? [Consistency, `TimelineEventInspector.tsx`]
- [ ] CHK015 Do the filter-chip requirements stay consistent with spec 038's shared filter, which the timeline already uses? [Consistency, Dependency, Gap]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Is SC-002's "two activations" defined for both surfaces, or only for the log row? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK017 Are acceptance criteria stated for the display layer at all, beyond reachability and counts? [Gap, Spec §Success Criteria]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for a session row whose prompt text is longer than the whole detail panel? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements stated for a turn holding hundreds of actions — does the action list itself page, cap, or scroll? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the behaviour specified when a filter leaves a session with exactly one matching member — does the row still read as a session? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK021 Are narrow-window requirements stated, given the log and detail share the panel's width? [Gap, Coverage]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK022 Are the UIUX-STANDARD constraints this feature must meet referenced explicitly — the 6:1 grey floor, hue reserved for status, §168 truncation, §117 hard gates — rather than assumed? [Traceability, Gap]
- [ ] CHK023 Is a requirement stated that folding must not regress timeline render or zoom responsiveness, with a threshold? [Gap, Measurability, plan §Performance Goals]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`
- This checklist has the highest proportion of `[Gap]` markers in the set; that is the finding, not an artifact of how it was written
